body.lit: [When Digivolving] Trash the top digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to its owner's hand.

label.lit: Trash digivolution cards and return 1 Digimon to hand

effects.opaque: addSkillClass.SetUpICardEffect("Opponent's Digimon trashes its digivolution card when it attacks", CanUseCondition, card);
